# Numeraise

> Free financial calculators for investments, loans, mortgages, retirement, and tax planning. Privacy-first, transparent mathematical formulas, multi-currency support, zero signup.

Numeraise (https://numeraise.com) provides 70+ client-side financial modeling tools with instant calculation engines, visual breakdown charts, and embeddable widgets.

## Core Capabilities
- **Multi-Currency Engine**: Dynamic conversion across USD ($), INR (₹), GBP (£), EUR (€), CAD (C$), AUD (A$), SGD (S$), and AED (د.إ).
- **Goal Presets**: 1-click milestone scenarios (e.g., $1M 401(k), ₹1 Crore SIP, $400k Home Loan).
- **Embeddable Widgets**: Embed interactive calculators on any website via `https://numeraise.com/embed/[slug]`.
- **Privacy First**: All calculations run locally in the client browser. No financial data is ever collected or transmitted.

## Calculators Directory

### Investment & Wealth Creation
- [SIP Calculator](https://numeraise.com/calculators/sip-calculator): Calculate Systematic Investment Plan returns with year-by-year compounding schedules.
- [SIP vs Lumpsum](https://numeraise.com/calculators/sip-vs-lumpsum): Compare monthly recurring investments against a one-time lump sum on identical CAGR assumptions.
- [Lumpsum Calculator](https://numeraise.com/calculators/lumpsum-calculator): One-time capital compounding trajectory.
- [Step-Up SIP](https://numeraise.com/calculators/step-up-sip): Model annual contribution step-ups matching salary increments.
- [CAGR Calculator](https://numeraise.com/calculators/cagr-calculator): Compound Annual Growth Rate between initial and final values.
- [SWP Calculator](https://numeraise.com/calculators/swp-calculator): Systematic Withdrawal Plan and corpus depletion estimator.
- [Mutual Fund Returns](https://numeraise.com/calculators/mutual-fund-returns): Absolute, annualized, and rolling mutual fund return analyzer.
- [Stock Profit Calculator](https://numeraise.com/calculators/stock-profit): Equity trading profit and loss after brokerage fees.
- [Net Worth Calculator](https://numeraise.com/calculators/net-worth-calculator): Total personal assets minus liabilities.
- [Dividend Yield](https://numeraise.com/calculators/dividend-yield): Current yield and yield-on-cost stock dividend calculator.

### Loans & Mortgages
- [EMI Calculator](https://numeraise.com/calculators/emi-calculator): Monthly loan installment calculator with complete amortization table.
- [Home Loan Calculator](https://numeraise.com/calculators/home-loan-calculator): Mortgage EMI, total interest, and prepayment impact.
- [US Mortgage Calculator](https://numeraise.com/calculators/us-mortgage-calculator): 15-year and 30-year fixed US mortgages with property tax and insurance.
- [Car Loan EMI](https://numeraise.com/calculators/car-loan-emi): Auto loan monthly payments and interest cost.
- [Personal Loan Calculator](https://numeraise.com/calculators/personal-loan-calculator): Unsecured loan repayment schedule.
- [Credit Card Payoff](https://numeraise.com/calculators/credit-card-payoff): Debt avalanche and payoff timeline estimator.
- [Loan Comparison](https://numeraise.com/calculators/loan-comparison): Side-by-side comparison of multiple loan offers.

### Retirement & FIRE
- [401(k) Calculator](https://numeraise.com/calculators/401k-calculator): US employer-sponsored 401(k) retirement growth with employer matching.
- [FIRE Calculator](https://numeraise.com/calculators/fire-calculator): Financial Independence, Retire Early target using the 4% rule.
- [Retirement Calculator](https://numeraise.com/calculators/retirement-calculator): Global retirement corpus requirement based on lifestyle expenses.
- [Pension Calculator](https://numeraise.com/calculators/pension-calculator): Annuity and monthly post-retirement pension estimator.
- [NPS Calculator](https://numeraise.com/calculators/nps-calculator): National Pension System compounding and annuity payout.

### Taxes & Payroll
- [Income Tax Calculator](https://numeraise.com/calculators/income-tax-calculator): Indian Old vs New Tax Regime side-by-side comparison.
- [Paycheck Calculator](https://numeraise.com/calculators/paycheck-calculator): US gross-to-net salary take-home estimator.
- [Sales Tax Calculator](https://numeraise.com/calculators/sales-tax-calculator): US state and local sales tax calculator.
- [VAT Calculator](https://numeraise.com/calculators/vat-calculator): UK/EU Value Added Tax inclusive and exclusive estimator.
- [GST Calculator](https://numeraise.com/calculators/gst-calculator): Goods and Services Tax calculator with custom rates.
- [Salary Calculator](https://numeraise.com/calculators/salary-calculator): CTC to in-hand monthly salary breakdown.

### Business & Financial Decision Making
- [Break-Even Calculator](https://numeraise.com/calculators/break-even-calculator): Units and revenue required to cover fixed and variable costs.
- [ROI Calculator](https://numeraise.com/calculators/roi-calculator): Return on Investment percentage and annualized gain.
- [Margin Calculator](https://numeraise.com/calculators/margin-calculator): Gross and net profit margin from cost and revenue.
- [Markup Calculator](https://numeraise.com/calculators/markup-calculator): Percentage markup over cost price.
- [Rent vs Buy](https://numeraise.com/calculators/rent-vs-buy): Comprehensive 10-year wealth comparison between renting and buying a home.
- [Lease vs Buy](https://numeraise.com/calculators/lease-vs-buy): Vehicle lease vs loan financing net cost analyzer.
- [Inflation Calculator](https://numeraise.com/calculators/inflation-calculator): Historical and future purchasing power depreciation.

## Educational Resources
- [Financial Blog](https://numeraise.com/blog): In-depth guides on personal finance strategies, compounding mechanics, and tax optimization.
- [Financial Glossary](https://numeraise.com/glossary): Definitions and formulas for personal finance terminology.
- [Side-by-Side Comparisons](https://numeraise.com/compare): Detailed strategy comparisons (e.g., SIP vs FD, Old vs New Tax Regime, Rent vs Buy).
